test: npm run contract:fuzz (Schemathesis ST201 on POST /api/login, test case 634Un2)
summary: SECURITY: POST /api/login with no body, `{}`, or any unknown email and no password returns 200 and a valid session cookie. Cause: demo-aut/server.mjs line 172 compares `USERS[body.email] !== body.password`; for an unknown email and a missing password both sides are `undefined`, so the check passes. The contract (requirements/openapi/orders.yaml) requires both email and password. The UI path is not affected (the form always sends a string password), so the REQ-101 UI tests stay green; only direct API callers can sign in without credentials. Suggested fix: reject when email or password is not a string, or check `body.email in USERS` first. Also seen (low priority, no requirement): undeclared methods such as TRACE /api/orders return 404 instead of 405 (Schemathesis ST204).
evidence: Reproduce with the AUT running: curl -X POST http://localhost:4173/api/login  -> 200 {"ok":true} with Set-Cookie. Schemathesis seed 12018546431711576721633235415082554832.
